caption: The drawing depicts a single rooster standing on a rounded, pale, rock-like base. The rooster is colored predominantly in shades of yellow and gold, with detailed feather patterns rendered on its body, wings, and tail. Its comb and wattle are reddish, while the beak appears black. The rooster's legs and feet are a darker, almost grayish color. The background is plain and light, providing contrast to the rooster, and there are no additional objects or scenery in the composition.
title: Gilded Wooden Rooster
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
